prompt: Why are there two tides a day? Answer live, as you think.
lines: @say The sea rises and falls twice a day because the Moon pulls on the Earth unevenly.
<ellipse cx="80" cy="60" rx="48" ry="34" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/>
@say scene=pull place=caption The near side is pulled a little more than the centre, and the far side a little less.
@say So the water stretches into two bulges, one towards the Moon and one away from it.
@show hold=1800 size=display Two bulges, one turning Earth
@say As the Earth turns under both bulges, every shore passes through two high tides a day.
